releases.notes:
## What's Changed

### Features
This release makes the C# logging Loki and Grafana friendly - by @zannagh in [#17](https://github.com/zannagh/eunomia/pull/17)

### Fixes
The Paper plugin is now published to Modrinth with every release, listing all supported game versions up to and including 26.3 (previously the latest Paper version on Modrinth was 0.2.0, which only went up to 26.2) - by @zannagh in [#19](https://github.com/zannagh/eunomia/pull/19). Thanks to MoShafiq98 for raising this in [armor-hider#389](https://github.com/zannagh/armor-hider/issues/389).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/zannagh/eunomia/compare/v0.3.14...v0.3.15
